excerpt: Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines is a 26B parameter model with 5.4B active. Its looped layers give it more computation per token than its size suggests, and it still fits on a Mac at about 20GB. It handles text and images, tool calls, and thinking, and scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified). ollama run inkling-2-mini Note: inkling-2-mini is supported on Apple silicon only in this release. PC support will follow in an upcoming release. What's Changed ollama launch claude supports Claude Code's deferred tool loading, so MCP tools are loaded when needed instead of all at once Ollama on Apple silicon now serves multiple requests at once. ollama launch opencode sets thinking options from the model's metadata ollama launch pi refreshes Pi's model list after sign-in and passes along prompt arguments ollama launch chatgpt --restore asks before switching an active profile and preserves existing settings and chat history; quitting ChatGPT yourself now lets it exit through its own quit prompt Running ollama with no arguments in a non-interactive shell prints help instead of erroring Ctrl+C or Ctrl+G while in a multiline """ block leaves multiline mode instead of swallowing the next line Changing the context shift setting no longer reloads the model Vulkan now uses mmap for integrated GPUs, fixing Failed to allocate pinned memory load failures on shared-memory GPUs On Windows iGPUs, partially offloaded models no longer fail to allocate the KV cache Tool definitions passed through the API keep JSON schema keywords Ollama doesn't model instead of dropping them Disabling thinking now maps to the model's lowest supported reasoning level rather than being ignored Source builds can use prebuilt MLX-C and XGrammar binaries Full Changelog: v0.40.16...v0.40.17-rc3
